Definition: Nethanjah, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Nethaniah is another name shared by four men, and the picks show three of them at work. One is the father of Ishmael who murders Gedaliah, one is a son of Asaph who prophesies with music under the king's order, and one is a Levite Jehoshaphat sends out to teach.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the same name can carry a murderer, a musician, and a teacher — and God judges each man by his own deeds, not his name.
